package main

// Positive control for TestCommentAuthorsCrossGHLogin (loginshape_guard_test.go): the guard
// must flag exactly the two PLANTED sites below and neither of the two sanctioned ones. Kept
// as .go.txt so the compiler never builds it.

func plantedKeyed(raw string) comment {
	return comment{Author: raw, Body: "PLANT-1"} // PLANT-1: raw REST login, no ghLogin
}

func plantedAssign(c *comment, raw string) {
	c.Author = raw // PLANT-2: raw REST login assigned after construction
}

func sanctionedKeyed(raw string) comment {
	return comment{Author: ghLogin(raw), Body: "ok"}
}

func sanctionedAssign(c *comment, raw string) {
	c.Author = ghLogin(raw)
}
